receptor_manifest.evidence: R8-Rh5/Rh6 cholinergic markers and Mi1 nicotinic receptor RNA, no detected ort/HisCl1 (Davis 2020 Fig8); R8 histamine/ACh cotransmission demonstrated (Xiao 2023).
receptor_manifest.uncertainty: Candidate net excitation of these existing R8p/R8y -> Mi1 pairs; not electrical measurement of their receptor, strength or time constant. RNA nondetection does not prove protein absence.
receptor_manifest.exclusions: R8d, R8_unclear, R7R8_unclear and every destination other than Mi1 are unchanged.
receptor_manifest.efficacy: effective weight = abs(stored signed weight) for these pairs only; no fitted magnitude

receptor_migration.changes: Postsynaptic effective sign only; state and release are continuous, but derivatives may change at adoption.
receptor_migration.preserved: Full neural/retinal/transmission state, clock, anatomical IDs/topology/signed weights, gains, thresholds and RNG.

measured_t4_manifest.receptor_localization_evidence: Sanfilippo et al. Fig6: tagged GluClalpha localizes postsynaptically at Mi9 contacts onto distal T4 dendrites. This establishes a receptor-associated connection type, not its reversal in this male preparation.

calibration.interpretation: Somatic T4 glutamate I-V constraint applied as an uncertain Mi9-to-T4 GluCl reversal; not a measured synaptic constant, per-edge strength, or global visual calibration.

measured_t4_manifest.equation: Add ((E_GluCl_mV+80)/80)*g_Mi9 to the normalized voltage numerator; total conductance and rate unchanged.
measured_t4_manifest.scope: Existing Mi9 -> graded T4a/b/c/d pairs only; no new edges, sign changes, gain fitting, input currents or direction decoder.

measured_t4_migration.preserved: All neural, retinal, transmission states, release, clock, weights, graph, gains and numerical parameters.
measured_t4_migration.changes: Only the derivative of selected T4 cells may change at adoption; no state jump.

r8_mi4_manifest.evidence: Davis 2020 Fig7A/Fig8C-D: R8 postsynaptic partner Mi4 expresses nicotinic ACh receptor subunits with no detected ort or HisCl1 RNA. Xiao 2023 demonstrates R8 histamine/ACh cotransmission.
r8_mi4_manifest.uncertainty: RNA nondetection does not establish protein absence. Net excitation of these particular male R8p/R8y -> Mi4 pairs is a hypothesis; cotransmission does not identify their receptor conductance, magnitude, reversal or time constant.
r8_mi4_manifest.exclusions: R8d, R8_unclear, R7R8_unclear, all other destinations and all Mi4 outputs retain their prior interpretation.
r8_mi4_manifest.efficacy: If enabled, effective weight = abs(stored signed weight) only for selected pairs; otherwise their original signed value. No magnitude fitting or new edges.
r8_mi4_manifest.preserved: Prior R8-to-Mi1 interpretation and Mi9-to-T4 GluCl reversal/calibration, all graph weights, gains, state and clock.

r8_mi4_migration.changes: Enabled: selected postsynaptic effective sign only; derivatives may change. Disabled: unchanged measured T4 dynamics.
r8_mi4_migration.preserved: Complete neural/retinal/transmission state and clock without jump; anatomical IDs, signed weights and magnitudes; all prior receptor policies and numerical parameters. This is a model revision, not learning.

graded_descending_manifest.canonical_alias: Dorkenwald 2024: DNOVS1; canonical MaleCNS v10 nodes.parquet synonyms
graded_descending_manifest.evidence: Suver et al. 2016 Fig3C: whole-cell DNOVS1 responses are purely graded, unlike the small spikes in DNOVS2 and DNHS1. Canonical DNp20 aliases identify these two candidate homologues.
graded_descending_manifest.limitations: The canonical crosswalk does not measure these male cells. Generic leak/reversals, conductance per weight, tau and release curve remain uncalibrated. Electrical coupling to VS is not represented or invented; chemical VS cuts cannot remove absent gap-junction paths.
graded_descending_manifest.coordinate: For enabled targets only: y=(15+40*r)/80; Vm=-80+80*y is a new model coordinate, not a measured initial potential. Chemical transmission is unchanged.
graded_descending_manifest.cut_scope: If vs_input_cut, zero the derived cache of existing canonical VS -> DNp20 pairs only; signed W remains intact. This diagnostic is not a candidate for active continuation.
graded_descending_manifest.global_cut_limit: Inherited visual_output_cut uses the expanded graded mask; it is not a specific VS/DNp20 control. Use the explicit VS-pair diagnostic for that question.
graded_descending_manifest.preserved: All other state coordinates, chemical history, graph, signed weights, gains, numerical settings, earlier receptor policies and clock.

graded_descending_migration.interpretation: One-time coordinate/model revision, not learning, measured basal Vm, state reset or ongoing clamp. Affine release continuity is algebraic; actual FP64 roundoff is retained explicitly.
graded_descending_migration.source_ownership: Consumes/replaces the old model on its shared brain. Source state is retained, but its float32 published view may change at the two targets as recorded; load a separate checkpoint to continue the reference.

cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.selection: Intersection of supplied real optical mapping, inherited photo_ids, and canonical R1-R6 type. No response selection.
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.release_equation: Inherited clip((80*Vnorm-15)/40,0,1). First-order luminance tracking is exact while Vnorm lies in [15/80,55/80].
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.interface_units: Normalized light 0..1 to normalized release 0..1 via existing voltage coordinate; neither measured voltage nor measured firing rate.
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.parameter_provenance: Fixed engineering choice before behavior, using the existing interface range; no behavioral gain fitting or physiological calibration.
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.replaced: Only selected voltage-row coefficients: recurrent inputs and native phototransduction no longer drive those rows when enabled.
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.retained: All state coordinates, old fast/adaptation variables and their evolution, canonical graph/weights/signs, gains, stored taus, existing chemical transmission and all other neural-row equations.
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.claim_scope: Tests the candidate CNS behind a prosthetic retina. Does not reconstruct retinal physiology or attribute the device transfer function to the animal.
cyborg_retinal_port_manifest.disabled_scope: Disabled leaves all inherited coefficients bit-for-bit unchanged.

pvlp_adaptation_manifest.initialization: New memory a=0; inherited state unchanged; pre-adoption adaptation history unavailable.
pvlp_adaptation_manifest.parameter_provenance: Explicit phenomenological hypothesis; beta and tau_s are not measured PVLP024 parameters.
pvlp_adaptation_manifest.scope: Intrinsic local feedback on each selected cell and all its existing outputs; no direction or motor signal.
pvlp_adaptation_manifest.inactive_error_policy: Memory evolves but is excluded from error norm when disabled or beta=0; inherited trajectory and solver decisions remain exact.

orn_pn_synaptic_manifest.device_scope: External rate input replaces only selected ORN-to-PN source terms; endogenous ORN outputs elsewhere and all other CNS equations remain active.
orn_pn_synaptic_manifest.control_scope: Rate-to-current sensory engineering with no stimulus identity, direction, reward or behavioral policy in the effector path.

orn_pn_synaptic_manifest.initialization_scope: New synaptic-history assumption; neither rested nor stationary states reconstruct unknown pre-adoption history.
orn_pn_synaptic_manifest.input: Held external afferent rate in spike/s units, supplied locally by the device; not endogenous ORN q, old transmission or a concentration-response measurement.
orn_pn_synaptic_manifest.gain_scope: Low-rate undepressed DC normalization, not a measured conductance/current transfer or gain preservation at finite depressed rates.
orn_pn_synaptic_manifest.inactive_error_policy: New states evolve but do not enter the error norm when disabled; parent state and solver decisions remain exact.

config.parameter_status: Explicit uncalibrated transfer hypothesis. Five values reuse the earlier tinybench; K is the anatomical median 267 gL contacts per KCgamma times a declared 1 model-Hz reference. This is neither a measured receptor affinity nor a fit to CNS memory or movement.
config.routing_hypothesis: Separate identified KCgamma-to-KCgamma gL contact fractions from the old fast whole-cell sum and supply local axonal ACh modulation. Preserve calyx/other fractions and unresolved outputs. At mapped axonal outputs, use a separate axonal release and chemical-filter state. gL location does not establish exclusively muscarinic transmission; that assignment remains an explicit intervention hypothesis.

controls.complete_bypass: Recover inherited effective currents and transmission exactly.
controls.eta_zero: Same regional adapter, axonal filters and initial state as the active arm; set only eta to zero.
controls.activity_independent_receptor: Subsequent mechanistic control h=1, with regional routing and other parameters retained. Do not use global mean suppression as evidence of the voltage-dependent mechanism.

config.remaining_implementation: Add the regional adapter to the CNS with explicit persistent x, b and axonal chemical-transmission states; specify their common initialization before any candidate trial and verify exact released/disabled behavior. Regional maps alone do not change neuronal equations.
config.validation_targets: Preserve useful upstream visual responses and stimulus-dependent axonal output; distinguish weak from strong response effects under receptor perturbation. Neither lower mean activity nor changing weights demonstrates learning. Use held-out optical conditions without retuning these parameters.

regional_manifest.initialization: x=q_soma; b=0; s_ax=old_s, same initialization for every eta. Earlier axonal/receptor history is unknown.
regional_manifest.bypass: All inherited currents and solver norm restored exactly; appended states frozen with rate zero.

regional_manifest.parameter_status: Explicit uncalibrated compartment/kinetic hypothesis; no observed behavioral fitting.

Young adult females, T4c/d-biased label, transferred to male T4a/b/c/d by type.

t4_gaba_manifest.other_inputs: All unselected GABA and other afferents keep their inherited reversal and contribution.

retinal_transduction_manifest.parameter_status: Biologically constrained population approximation with uncalibrated optical/conductance gain and bump filter.
retinal_transduction_manifest.initialization: New A,z at stationary values for current pending light. Earlier microvillus history unknown. Existing voltage/transmission/body are unchanged.

lai_receptor.mechanism: Amacrine glutamate excites photoreceptor EKAR; transfer AC identity to canonical Lai.
lai_receptor.scope: Only existing Lai->mapped R1-R6 terminals; use magnitude of inherited weight as excitatory conductance. No stored weight changes.
lai_receptor.limitation: Polarity supported; generic0mV reversal, per-contact conductance and5ms chemical filter remain model assumptions. No Ih channel reconstruction.

retinal_transduction_manifest.voltage_equation: target=(0.25+g_exc+1.25*g_photo)/(1+g_exc+g_inh+g_photo); rate=(1+g_exc+g_inh+g_photo)/inherited_tau. All local canonical chemical inputs included.
retinal_transduction_manifest.supersedes: Historical R1-R6 voltage clamp and its old fast/adaptation contribution on selected rows only; old states remain as inactive historical coordinates there.
retinal_transduction_manifest.bypass: Parent coefficients and solver error norm exactly restored; new states frozen.

cvn7_manifest.parameter_status: Quasi-stationary LIF conductance-to-rate prosthesis. CvN7 rest/Rin range midpoints; other electrical quantities remain transferred or inherited model priors.

cvn7.scope: Somatic current-clamp in female CvN7 at22C, no holding current; current injection elicits spikes. Transfer to two MaleCNS identities uses range midpoints.
cvn7.limitation: Rin includes morphology and active/resting synaptic contributions; its inverse is an effective input-conductance scale, not measured isolated leak.

lif_priors.scope: Shiu2024 model priors: membrane tau20ms, threshold-45mV, refractory2.2ms; not measurements of CvN7. Reset-50mV equals the selected resting-range midpoint.

inhibitory_reversal.scope: The T4/Groschner equivalent GABA reversal-68mV is transferred as an inhibitory prior to all negative CvN7 inputs, including glutamate. This does not identify their receptors or establish their true reversals.

shared_hypotheses: Existing weight signs are retained; positive weights use0mV and negative weights use-68mV. No transmitter label overrides a stored sign.
abs(weight)*inherited conductance_per_stored_weight*filtered normalized transmission is a conductance relative to effective resting input conductance; no presynaptic rate cap factor.
All incoming chemical pairs remain; per-contact conductance and common transmission kinetics are unmeasured CvN7 hypotheses.
Rin sets nS units and derived C_pF=tau_s*1e6/Rin_MOhm. Rin cancels from Vinf and firing-transfer predictions.
No Vm or spike-event state is added. Stationary LIF frequency is divided by the inherited target cap and clipped to[0,1].
The inherited target-neuron tau remains the output-rate low-pass time constant; it is distinct from the20ms membrane prior.
Nonzero direct current has no supported conversion into this conductance model and must fail.
No behavioral feedback, desired movement, parameter fitting or observed voltage trace is supplied to the neuron.

cvn7_manifest.equation: gE/gI=sum(abs(weight)*scale*s_pre) by inherited sign; Vinf=(Erest+gE*Eexc+gI*Einh)/(1+gE+gI); tau_eff=20ms/(1+gE+gI); f_inf=stationary_LIF(Vinf,tau_eff); qtarget=min(f_inf/cap_target,1); dq/dt=(qtarget-q)/inherited_tau_target.
cvn7_manifest.state_contract: Unchanged normalized rate coordinates and transmission states; no Vm state or spike events. All inherited CNS state and anatomy persist.
cvn7_manifest.bypass: When disabled return parent coefficients exactly; unchanged state, solver norm, visual gate and prior parameters.
cvn7_manifest.direct_drive_policy: Nonzero or nonfinite CvN7 direct drive is unsupported and rejected; no invented model-current to pA conversion.

boundary_manifest.conductance_status: Median anatomical contacts for the target type with exactly six canonical R1-R6 inputs, multiplied by inherited .001 relative conductance/contact. Not measured nS or reconstructed missing contacts.
boundary_manifest.membrane_tau_status: 20ms mean of the inherited random membrane prior; no photoreceptor electrical calibration.
boundary_manifest.initialization: New external sensor A,z,u,s at equilibrium of current pending optical image; all pre-existing neural and body history preserved. Earlier external sensor history is unknown.
boundary_manifest.scope: External achromatic retinal apparatus at canonical L1/L2 without any canonical R1-R6 pair; shared sensor per column. No new brain neuron IDs or anatomical edges.
boundary_manifest.boundary_direction: Feedforward apparatus; no invented feedback from L1/L2 to the missing receptor.
boundary_manifest.bypass: When disabled, parent coefficients and error norm are unchanged; four added states per sensor are frozen.

manifest.anatomical_scope: MaleCNS v1.0 actual ALPN acetylcholine consensus -> canonical KCgamma pairs. No new IDs or edges. Pair weights and all other afferents retained. No within-pair compartment or claw reconstruction.
manifest.physiological_source: Turner, Bazhenov & Laurent 2008, doi:10.1152/jn.01283.2007, p736; in-vivo Canton-S females, KC population. Alpha/beta estimated from voltage clamp; pulse shape is a published model assumption. Transfer to MaleCNS gamma cells is a cross-animal/type approximation.
manifest.equation: mean-field db/dt = k*f_PN*(1-b)-beta*b; k=alpha*A*duration=0.375, beta=400/s; f_PN=canonical q*caps; effective_rate=(beta/k)*b
manifest.replaced: The inherited generic 5ms transmission state only in the identified PN->KCgamma terms. The old PN transmission state and all its other projections continue.
manifest.remaining_prosthesis: Rate-to-mean-transmitter closure, homogeneous receptors across targets, contact-weight-to-current scale and KC rate/excitability transfer. This is receptor kinetics, not a recovered voltage-dependent conductance or full Kenyon cell.
manifest.initialization: Set b=k/beta*inherited PN filtered rate, preserving initial PN drive; older receptor history unknown.

pnkc_receptor_manifest.equation: db/dt=k*f_PN*(1-b)-beta*b; f_PN=q_PN*caps_PN; effective_rate=(beta/k)*b; retain original pair weight.
pnkc_receptor_manifest.initialization: b=k/beta*previous PN filtered rate; match initial branch current, unknown earlier receptor history.
pnkc_receptor_manifest.compression: One state per PN for identical receptor kinetics and identical initialization at its selected KC terminals. Individual anatomical pair strengths remain stored and applied.
pnkc_receptor_manifest.source_scope: Turner2008 female population voltage-clamp kinetic estimates transferred to male gamma KC; mean transmitter rather than explicit PN spikes.
remaining_prostheses: Rate-to-mean-transmitter closure; homogeneous kinetics across mapped terminals
Inherited anatomical-contact-to-current scale; low-rate strength normalization is an interface assumption
KC rate transfer and excitability; no KC membrane voltage or full voltage-dependent synaptic conductance
APL remains the inherited neural component, without a localized graded electrical replacement
pnkc_receptor_manifest.changed_term: Only mapped ALPN->KCgamma release filter; all other afferents and PN projections retained.

manifest.remaining_prosthesis: Existing gamma-lobe x/b/sax kinetics are uncalibrated hypotheses. Post ROI fraction localizes the contact, not the receptor identity. Unknown/unmapped terms and non-gamma fractions remain on their original transmission.

kcgamma_output_manifest.equation: release_eff=(1-f_gL)*old_filtered_soma + f_gL*persisted_filtered_axon; apply original signed pair weight and cap.
kcgamma_output_manifest.region_scope: Only additional mapped non-KCgamma ordinary-rate targets. Existing specialized transfers remain authoritative; unassigned and non-gamma fractions remain inherited.
retained_prostheses: Gamma axonal kinetics and contact-to-current scales are inherited hypotheses, without new fitting.
Anatomical ROI does not identify receptor subtype or prove functional strength.
APL/KC/MBON rate transfer, local APL release and complete neuromodulation remain incomplete.

APL.scope: Rest/Rin medians from deposited NS APL; RC tau from one verified NS hyperpolarizing record. Whole-cell, unlocalized, non-spiking passive closure.

parameters.APL_release: clip((V-rest)/(0-rest),0,1); inherited output cap retained only as transmitter normalization, not Hz
parameters.KC_transfer: Stationary conductance LIF frequency with subtype rest/Rin/tau/somatic threshold, reset=rest and fixed refractory; inherited output-rate filter. No KC voltage/spike events are integrated.
parameters.output_ceiling: Existing canonical cap retained; raw f and cap exposure are reported separately.

limitations: Stationary LIF with a rate filter is a replaceable reduced transfer, not a mechanistic KC spike generator or a fit to experimental f-I curves.

Reset=rest and refractory2.2ms are published-model priors, not KC measurements. Somatic thresholds are transferred to an effective whole-cell coordinate, not claimed as measured axonal initiation thresholds.
Measured Rin and tau define effective resting conductance and capacitance; extrapolation under large conductance and rapid synaptic fluctuations remains approximate.
Absolute contacts->nS, other-afferent synapse scaling, E_inh=-68mV and graded APL release retain the preceding declared interface priors.
APL is one passive nonspiking compartment per canonical cell; local GABA release, spatial propagation and SK adaptation remain unresolved.
Only two APL voltage states are added. KC states remain normalized rate coordinates. All other afferents, axonal routing and PN receptor occupancy are retained.
Raw current-injection curves are diagnostic comparators only; no passive voltage is converted back to an injected current to read them.

source.coupling: Symmetric mean-field exchange Gij=gLtotal*kappa*fi*fj, kappa=(50/180)^2. Equal hub reduction is an engineering prior motivated by Amin locality, NOT the published branched cable or recovered male distances.
source.area: Per-APL fractions of incoming plus outgoing regional contact counts; unmeasured area/capacitance proxy including outside_selected_MB. Total gL and C preserved. Zero-contact regions have zero electrical area.
source.KC: Exact held-conductance LIF events; Vreset=rest, refractory 2.2ms model priors, subtype somatic NS population properties. Existing gamma axonal and PN mean-occupancy history retained.
source.APL: Two canonical nonspiking cells with 15 regional voltage/output/filter slots each; passive RC and conservative finite coupling. No fitted AHP or SK conductance.
source.conductance_status: Eight separate interface parameters initialized to the inherited reference prior. Only the cholinergic PN-KC reference has a miniature-current anchor. Other excitation, all inhibition, and APL release normalization are NOT electrically calibrated; equality is not a biological claim.
source.inputs: Existing DM1 afferent device: 7Hz baseline, 20Hz or 50Hz for 150ms. These are two intensity patterns on the same channel, not two reconstructed odors. Kazama/Wilson VM2 rates transferred as device settings.
source.initialization: New KC/APL voltages at subtype rest, refractory/spike history starts at zero; all inherited states preserved, APL local release/history initialized uniformly from inherited scalar states.
source.output_ceiling: Each spike adds 1/(cap_Hz*tau_s); any inherited q ceiling is counted separately. Raw event counts never clipped.
source.numerical_scope: First-order operator splitting; held neural outputs lag by <=250us. Exact event crossings under frozen input, backward Euler conservative APL, adaptive exponential midpoint for remaining CNS. Local checks include time-step and coupling sensitivity.

PN_KCgamma.waveform: Two unit-area first-order filters; assume the reported1.23ms rising interval is time to peak. The paper does not specify10-90%. Alternative convention assessed locally; no waveform parameter fitted to CNS output.
PN_KCgamma.amplitude_scope: Somatically observed quantal current in isolated adult female201Y+ population enriched for gamma; n=5. Includes event-detection censoring at3pA. Erev0mV retained as a model assumption, not measured in this preparation.
PN_KCgamma.pair_mapping: Inherited one-effective-quantal-event per PN event at18EM contacts; pair factor contacts/18. Not inferred release probability per active zone, and not a measured unitary PN-KC conductance.
PN_KCgamma.rate_scope: PN output remains a rate; linear mean of event kernels, not a reconstructed PN spike train or receptor occupancy saturation law.

APL_KCgamma.interface: gI_pair_nS=gbar_pair_nS*regional_release; regional_release is dimensionless, not Hz
APL_KCgamma.initialization: gbar_pair=abs(inherited_weight)*inherited_APL_cap*inherited_gamma_inhibitory_scale, evaluated once at adoption; persist the resulting nS values.
APL_KCgamma.reversal_status: Inherited unvalidated KC prior; no transplantation of cultured-cell chloride reversal.

excluded_GABA_calibration.reason: Different electrotonic geometry and internal chloride; no identification of APL release. Cannot convert this miniature current to tonic conductance of adult canonical APL pairs.

source.scope: Separate projection units and replace PN miniature amplitude/charge reference. APL absolute calibration remains unresolved; do not interpret a recovered firing pattern as parameter identification.

kc_electrical_scales_manifest.initialization: PN slow filter matches previous conductance per pair; fast filter initialized from current PN rate. Older waveform history is unknown. All existing neural/body coordinates preserved.

inputs.APL_location: CA to dendrites; PED to SIZ proxy; named MB lobes to entire axon; outside_selected_MB to soma proxy. Region fractions and regional release are multiplied before summing, preserving their correlation.
inputs.other_inputs: All non-PN/non-APL canonical inputs remain in the soma proxy with their inherited nS scale.
inputs.unresolved: ROI is not an electrotonic coordinate. PED/SIZ and uniform intra-region distributions are explicit hypotheses, not measured local synapse placements.

kc_spatial_manifest.initialization: Every inherited coordinate preserved. New hidden voltage ports start at source WT9 leak rest; soma coordinate matches inherited midpoint voltage. Gates start at steady state of these declared initial voltages. No older spatial history is inferred.
kc_spatial_manifest.legacy_gamma_voltage: Inactive historical LIF voltage/refractory fields retained; authoritative gamma voltage and gates are kc_spatial_state. Cumulative event counts continue in both ledgers.
kc_spatial_manifest.output: Causal SIZ local maxima above-40mV with past-trough prominence20mV drive inherited q filter. No voltage reset or membrane clipping. Previous regional output/release filters remain downstream proxies.

kc_axonal_manifest.event_criterion: Past local maximum above -40mV with prominence >=20mV; same declared criterion as spatial SIZ ledger; no voltage reset.
kc_axonal_manifest.release_equation: Local event q decays with inherited neuronal tau; each event adds 1/(cap*tau). Exact synaptic cascade of q/(1+eta*b) uses inherited synaptic tau. Events enter at the right endpoint.
kc_axonal_manifest.routing: Area-weighted twelve-band axonal release replaces x/s_ax summaries only. Existing gamma-lobe contact fractions and other synapses are preserved. WT9 bands are not assigned to canonical gamma1-5.
kc_axonal_manifest.initialization: Local q/s begin at inherited regional x/s_ax in every band; peak detectors begin at saved axonal voltages with no invented preceding slope or spikes.

kc_visual_manifest.source: Ganguly et al.2024 doi:10.1038/s41467-024-49616-z, Figure1 and PDFpage3; canonical route identity from saved route manifest.

route_manifest.historical_alias_status: VFB/FlyBase anatomy ontology FBbt_20002842 maps LOPN to SLP448/LoVP65 using Li2020 bodyIDs. FBbt_00051252 maps PLPPN to hemibrain SLP360,SLP362,SLP371. Canonical matches use the MaleCNS author hemibrainType field; cross-specimen type correspondence, not measured male physiology.
